title: Legacy program as a dummy program that keeps physicists out

tellings.quote: But an alternate hypothesis is that this is a dummy program masking something. And the last thing that you would want ever on such a program is a physicist.

plain: Eric Weinstein, a mathematician and commentator, suggests on Jesse Michels's podcast that the so-called legacy program, the long-running secret effort said to study recovered craft at an established aerospace company, might be a dummy program hiding something else. Pointing to the experience of a scientist named Bernie Haisch, he argues that the last thing such a decoy would want is a real physicist on board. If true, the program people talk about would be a cover for the real work.
